title: 第24章 进入府邸
novel_title: 开局暴打渣男，我带九个道侣飞升
content_zh:
“哇！主人，那下面有座好大的房子，是神仙住的地方吗？”墨燃也看到了华光镜映照出的地底殿宇虚影，大大的眼睛里满是惊叹。

    路仙瑶只和他说来苍山，并未和他说是来寻找红月上仙的府邸。

    既然带着他一道来的，他也瞧见了，就没必要瞒他，便点头回道：“嗯，这是红月上仙的府邸。”

    “红月上仙？就是那位数万年前的仙子？这里是她的府邸啊？那岂不是有很多法宝？”墨燃眼中亮晶晶的。

    他一高兴，狐狸尾巴便不由得露出来。

    果然是只小狐狸，什么心绪都藏不住，路仙瑶嘴角不由得挂上一抹弧度，“放心，不会少了你的。”

    “那墨燃就先谢过主人啦！嘿嘿…”

    但眼下路仙瑶面对的问题是府邸在地下，要如何进去？

    就算她有开山符，以她的修为也催不动啊？

    “主人，那是什么花？好漂亮啊！”

    就在路仙瑶犯难时，墨燃的声音打断了她的思路，她抬头，顺着他指的方向望去，看到山脉下方有一簇不起眼的花丛，盛开着细碎的蓝紫色小花。

    这花丛看起来没什么特别的，但灵气却异常浓郁！

    有问题！

    而且，还是很大的问题！

    整个山脉都被领域覆盖，就连她的灵力都被压制，一簇花丛怎么会灵气那么浓郁？

    像是地底下是翻滚的熔浆，这簇花丛是火山爆发口一样……

    “主人，我想去摘，可以吗？”墨燃一双圆溜溜的眼睛，期盼地看着路仙瑶。

    “好，我带你去摘。”路仙瑶刚好也想看看，这簇花丛为何会灵气如此浓郁。

    她驾驭着飞舟缓缓落地，也有几只鸟儿被花簇的灵气吸引了过来，叽叽喳喳围堵着花簇，仿佛在争论着谁更有实力吸纳这里的灵气。

    看得路仙瑶有些好笑。

    就在她目光被鸟儿吸引时，墨燃的脚尖看似随意，却蕴含着精妙力道，踩在花簇旁一块颜色略深，微微凹陷的石头上。

    “咔嚓——”

    一声轻微的机括声响起。

    紧接着，脚下的地面毫无征兆地向下塌陷！

    “啊！”

    路仙瑶还未清楚发生了什么，只感觉到身体失重往下坠落，眼前一阵天旋地转，仿佛穿过了一层粘稠的水幕。

    她连忙丢出飞舟接住自己，这才没有撞到下方的岩石地面。
content_en:
"Wow! Master, there is a big house down there. Is it where the gods live?" Mo Ran also saw the shadow of the underground palace reflected by the Huaguang Mirror, and his big eyes were filled with wonder.

    Lu Xianyao only told him that she came to Cangshan Mountain, but did not tell him that she came to look for the residence of the Red Moon Immortal.

    Since he came with him and he saw it, there was no need to hide it from him, so he nodded and replied: "Well, this is the residence of the Red Moon Immortal."

    "Red Moon Immortal? Is that the fairy from tens of thousands of years ago? Is this her mansion? Aren't there many magic weapons?" Mo Ran's eyes were bright.

    When he was happy, the fox's tail couldn't help but show out.

    As expected, he is just a little fox. He can't hide any of his emotions. Lu Xianyao couldn't help but curl her lips, "Don't worry, I won't miss you."

    "Then Mo Ran will thank the master first! Hehe..."

    But the problem Lu Xianyao faces now is that the mansion is underground, how to get in?

    Even if she has the Mountain Opening Talisman, she can't do it with her cultivation level?

    "Master, what kind of flower is that? It's so beautiful!"

    Just when Lu Xianyao was in trouble, the ink-burning voice interrupted her thoughts. She raised her head and looked in the direction he pointed, and saw a cluster of inconspicuous flowers below the mountain range, with tiny blue-purple flowers in full bloom.

    This flower bush looks nothing special, but its aura is extremely rich!

    There's a problem!

    Moreover, it is still a big problem!

    The entire mountain range was covered by the domain, and even her spiritual power was suppressed. How could a cluster of flowers have such strong spiritual energy?

    It's like there is rolling lava under the ground, and these flowers are like the crater of a volcano...

    "Master, I want to pick it, is it okay?" Mo Ran looked at Lu Xianyao expectantly with a pair of round eyes.

    "Okay, I'll take you to pick it." Lu Xianyao happened to want to see why this cluster of flowers has such strong aura.

    She piloted the flying boat and landed slowly, and several birds were attracted by the aura of the flower clusters. They chirped and surrounded the flower clusters, as if they were arguing about who had the strength to absorb the aura here.

    Lu Xianyao looked a little funny.

    Just when her eyes were attracted by the bird, the ink-burning toes seemed casual, but contained exquisite strength, stepping on a slightly darker and slightly sunken stone next to the flower cluster.

    "Click——"

    There was a slight mechanical sound.

    Immediately afterwards, the ground beneath his feet collapsed downwards without warning!

    "Ah!"

    Lu Xianyao didn't know what happened yet. She only felt her body falling downwards without weight. The world was spinning in front of her eyes, as if she had passed through a thick curtain of water.

    She quickly threw the flying boat to catch herself before hitting the rocky ground below.
